name: Konark Sun Chariot Wheels
competency: Decomposing numbers into pairs, recognizing commutative properties of addition, and completing hub-and-spoke representations
ncertStandard: Grade 1 & 2 Mathematics: NCERT Joyful Mathematics (Number Pairs & Wheels)
overview: Inspired by the Konark Sun Chariot wheels in the NCERT textbook, children complete addition pairs on wheel spokes such that each pair sums up to the central sun hub.
learningOutcomes: Decompose numbers (5, 7, 8, 9) into additive component pairs
Observe and apply the commutative property of addition (e.g. 1+8 = 8+1 = 9)
Strengthen mental math recall for addition fact families

levels.name: Konark Chariot Wheel of 9
levels.description: Full 8-spoke chariot wheel with hub sum of 9
